views.markdown: PanoramaPages turns Home Screen pages into windows onto one continuous image. Choose a wide photo in Settings and it moves smoothly as you swipe.

- Select, replace, or remove a dedicated panorama
- Tune image span and direction without a respring
- Keeps the effect behind icons and outside the Lock Screen
- Optional LiquidAss Snapshot compatibility on validated systems
- Includes arm64 and arm64e slices
Version 0.3.6 allows installation on iOS 27 with a compatible Rootless or RootHide environment. The iOS 27.1 Duo test was performed in vPhone. iOS 18 and later require a selected custom panorama.

### 0.3.8

- Keep the panorama scrolling after returning from an app on older iOS versions when a system overlay retains key-window status.

### 0.3.7

- Host the custom panorama in a UIKit-managed background view on iOS 26 and later to avoid obscuring icons during app-switcher transitions.

### 0.3.6

- Allow the public Rootless and RootHide packages to install on iOS 27.

### 0.3.5

- Keep the panorama viewport fixed during app-switcher zoom on iOS 26 and later.
- Recover the panorama after iOS 27 Duo display changes or when returning to the Home Screen in vPhone.

### 0.3.1

- Added an iOS 26 Home-window compatibility path.
- Moved the iOS 26 panorama layer inside the root Home Screen branch so new composition containers cannot cover it.
- Added one-time diagnostics for Home-window and layer-host selection.
- Kept the iOS 18+ system-wallpaper fallback disabled; select a custom panorama instead.

### 0.3.0

- Unified the validated iOS 18 path into the standard rootless package.
- Added public distribution artwork and metadata.
